findings.description: The endpoint does not have any security requirements defined, making it potentially unauthenticated.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add security requirements to the endpoint or ensure global security covers this endpoint.
findings.title: Endpoint missing security definition

findings.description: A string parameter does not have a maxLength constraint, potentially allowing very large inputs.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add reasonable maxLength constraints to all string parameters.
findings.title: String parameter missing maxLength constraint

findings.description: The OpenAPI specification does not define rate limiting using x-ratelimit extensions.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add x-ratelimit extensions to document rate limiting policies.
findings.title: Missing x-ratelimit extension in spec

findings.description: A numeric parameter does not have minimum or maximum value constraints.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add appropriate minimum and maximum constraints to all numeric parameters.
findings.title: Numeric parameter missing minimum/maximum constraints

findings.description: Endpoint does not define any 4xx (client error) responses.
findings.fix_suggestion: Define appropriate 4xx responses (400, 401, 403, 404) for all endpoints.
findings.title: Endpoint missing 4xx error responses

findings.description: API paths should include a version number (e.g., /api/v1/...) for better backward compatibility.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add version prefixes to all API paths (e.g., /v1, /v2).
findings.title: API path missing version number

findings.description: Endpoint does not define any 5xx (server error) responses.
findings.fix_suggestion: Define 500 response for all endpoints to document server error handling.
findings.title: Endpoint missing 5xx error responses
